name: Flow | 50mg Rosin Gummies | Strawberry Guava
description: Flow Rosin Gummies are crafted for precise microdosing, delivering 1mg of THC per gummy for a total of 50mg per package. Made with solventless rosin, they provide a full-spectrum experience that preserves natural cannabinoids and terpenes. These low-dose gummies are ideal for consumers seeking mild, controlled effects throughout the day, offering a convenient option for maintaining balance without overwhelming potency.
